messages:
Noah: Quick question 1 started a permanent 0.8 FTE transition on 2025-12-15. I have ~20h PTO on the ledger. Policy says 8h carryover max 1m trying to understand pro-rata rules when moving to part-time — can I carry 8h or is it prorated to my new FTE?
Priya: Congrats on the transition! Im the manager. The switch was approved but not sure how carryover math works for mid-cycle FTE changes. Tagging People Ops.
Elena (People Ops): Short answer: carryover caps apply to the employees entitlement at the time the year closes. For mid-year FTE changes we prorate accruals and carryover based on effective FTE during the accrual period. That said, were flexible when the change is company-initiated or due to parental/medical reasons.
Noah: This was my request for flexible hours, not a company layoff. Is there a formula I can see?
Elena: Formula we use internally: prorated_carryover = max_carryover * (avg_FTE_over_accrual_period). But we also compare to actual unused hours and choose the lesser. Example: max_carryover=8h, avg_FTE for year = (1.0 * Jan-Nov + 0.8 * Dec)/12 ~ 0.99 => effectively 7.92h ~ 7.75h rounded down to nearest 0.25h.
Priya: So Noah would likely get ~7.75h carryover (rounded) not full 8h?
Noah: OK that's fair. Can we round up to help me? I have an offsite first week of Jan and want a small buffer.
Elena: Exceptional rounding is discretionary. If manager approves and People Ops flags a business continuity reason we can allow up to +0.5h rounding. For anything above that we require a formal exception.
Priya: I approve rounding up to 8h for Noah to cover the offsite buffer. Posting approval now in BambooHR.
Priya: /pto note --user @Noah --note "manager approves rounding to 8h carryover due to Jan offsite"
BambooHR Bot: Manager note recorded for Noah: "manager approves rounding to 8h carryover due to Jan offsite" on 2025-12-29T11:02:00Z.
Noah: Great thanks. Anything else I need to file?
Elena: Yes 1 please file CE-7777 at https://redwood.company/hr/pto-exception selecting "prorate/rounding" and attach the BambooHR manager note. Payroll cutoff for carryover processing is 2026-01-04 18:00 UTC.
Noah: Submitted CE-7777 with attached BambooHR screenshot.
People Ops Bot: CE-7777 received: reason="FTE change prorate+rounding"; manager note present. Routing to Payroll Ops for finalization.
Payroll Bot: Acknowledged CE-7777. Note: final carryover amount will be calculated by Payroll using the payroll ledger effective FTE weights. If CE approved, payroll will post the carryover in Jan ledger. Cutoff: 2026-01-04 18:00 UTC.
Elena: Logging DOC-4001 to clarify FTE-change rounding policy and add a short calculator in the Help Center.
Noah: One more Q 1m switching to part-time after the cutoff (effective Jan 1) 1m concerned accrual formula might double-count. Will Payroll handle that?
Payroll Bot: If FTE effective date is on or after 2026-01-01 we use the previous years FTE distribution for carryover math. Any special cases should be noted in the CE form.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Im marking approved from manager side.
Noah: Appreciate the quick answers  saved me a panic. :relieved:
People Ops Bot: Thread status: awaiting payroll processing for CE-7777. Will post final carryover confirmation once payroll runs.
